title: Change a setting of an input device
summary: Modify a specific property of an input device, such as acceleration or button mapping. Requires the device ID, property ID, and new value.

steps.explain: Set a property value for the device. Use 'xinput list-props' to find the property ID.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the input device.

placeholders.name: SETTING_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the property to change.

placeholders.name: VALUE
placeholders.description: The new value for the property.
